howto.title: How to Use
howto.subtitle: Whether you're looking for work or hiring — get started in just a few simple steps.

step1.title: Sign Up & Create Your Profile
step1.description: Register using your phone number, email, or Google account. Complete your profile with your role (worker or employer), location, skills, and contact details.

step2.title: Browse or Post Jobs
step2.description: Workers can search for daily-wage jobs near their location filtered by trade, pay, and distance. Employers can post job openings with clear details like wages, skills needed, and duration.

step3.title: Apply or Hire
step3.description: Workers apply to jobs with a single tap. Employers review verified profiles, compare applicants, and shortlist or hire directly from their dashboard.

step4.title: Chat & Coordinate
step4.description: Use the built-in chat to discuss job details, timing, and location. Get real-time notifications so you never miss an update.

step5.title: Get Paid Securely
step5.description: Complete the work and receive payment through the integrated Razorpay system. Transparent wages, no surprises — just honest work and fair pay.

about.desc1: DayCraft is a bilingual daily-wage labour platform built for India's informal workforce. We bring together workers seeking reliable income and employers needing trusted local talent — through a fast, location-aware experience that works on any device.
about.desc2: From construction to home services, repair work to deliveries — DayCraft makes hiring transparent, verified, and hassle-free.
